name: Classify a keyword list
prompt: Classify these keywords by intent and tell us what to prioritize.
expected_behavior: Inspects live SERPs for ambiguous/high-value terms instead of guessing intent
Classifies each keyword by intent, journey stage, and AI-answer risk
Returns prioritized Targets, Authority keywords, and Deprioritize lists
Notes zero-click AI Overview risk where present

name: Intent from the SERP, not the string
prompt: Is 'best exam prep app' commercial or informational?
expected_behavior: Checks the live SERP's dominant result type to infer intent
Avoids classifying purely from the keyword wording
Explains the evidence behind the classification

name: Zero-click / AI risk triage
prompt: Which of these keywords are at risk from AI answers?
expected_behavior: Rates AI-answer risk HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW per keyword
Flags definition/fact/simple-how-to terms as high zero-click risk
Recommends defending high-value terms via aeo-content-optimizer

name: Clustering to avoid cannibalization
prompt: Group these keywords so we don't write competing pages.
expected_behavior: Recommends one target page per intent cluster
Flags cannibalization risk across the list
Hands off to ai-seo / seo-content-brief-writer for execution
